title: ModuleTaskService
responsibility: Admit immutable role-specific exact file grants against the selected committed HEAD registry; persist shared feature context and wanted-contract hashes; format contract-checked, feature-first worker prompts with contract-only app-wide discovery; and requeue only failed tasks or confirmed abandoned claims. This service exposes no task-cancellation operation. Assign untouched ad hoc queued tasks to a named worker without changing plan-bound task definitions or execution history.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Repository working-tree root. Defaults to process.cwd(). Constructs the public readonly repository property with the same root.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskService.feature.input
inputs.description: Strict parsed feature record {id, goal, tldr}, using the committed featureSchema contract: id is a lowercase unit-style identifier; goal and tldr are trimmed non-empty text up to 16000 characters.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskService.add.input
inputs.description: Strict taskInputSchema input parsed as ModuleTaskInput: id, title, feature id, module id, instructions and wantedContract; optional moduleGoal, verificationFiles, assignedFiles, provider, intelligence and assignee; role is implementation or verification and defaults to implementation; model defaults to auto. assignedFiles, when present, is a nonempty list of at most 64 canonical exact relative file names. verificationFiles remains an explicit test or verification file list capped at 64. wantedContract is strict with responsibility, inputs, outputs and errors; each item requires trimmed non-empty name/type, optional description and JSON examples, and outputs has at least one item. Text is trimmed non-empty up to 16000 characters; model is up to 150 characters; provider is claude or codex; intelligence is low, medium, high, xhigh, max or ultra; assignee is an optional unit-style id.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskService.list
inputs.description: Reads the task repository snapshot.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskService.schema
inputs.description: Returns the JSON Schema generated from the same taskInputSchema used by add.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskService.show.id
inputs.description: Exact task id to find in the repository snapshot.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskService.prompt.id
inputs.description: Exact task id whose committed task data will be formatted into a worker prompt.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskService.prepare.task
inputs.description: Stored ModuleTask passed directly to synchronous prompt construction and model/provider selection. role selects implementation or verification; module.files is the frozen admitted file grant. Legacy records without role default to implementation.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskService.prepare.commit
inputs.description: Task-queue commit string inserted into the formatted worker prompt.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskService.retry.id
inputs.description: Exact stored task id to requeue if it is failed or its same-clone running claim is confirmed abandoned.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskService.review.id
inputs.description: Exact stored task id passed through to the reviewModuleTask dependency.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskService.review.input
inputs.description: Passed through unchanged to reviewModuleTask; its dependency contract does not specify this input shape.

inputs.name: queuedTask.input
inputs.description: Validated task definition used to create a stored queued task.

inputs.name: queuedTask.feature
inputs.description: Previously committed shared feature context attached to the task.

inputs.name: queuedTask.unit
inputs.description: Active committed registry manifest selected at the task source revision. The helper reads id, responsibility, responsibilityOrigin and owns.source; ownership entries may be exact paths, directory prefixes or supported wildcard patterns.

inputs.name: queuedTask.sourceCommit
inputs.description: Committed source revision associated with the task.

inputs.name: queuedTask.files
inputs.description: Optional final file list to freeze into module.files. ModuleTaskService.add passes the already validated taskGrantFiles result. Direct callers that bypass add must call taskGrantFiles with the selected CommitTreeAdapter, await validateTaskGrant, and pass the validated list; queuedTask itself does not perform grant or filesystem admission.

inputs.name: taskGrantFiles.input
inputs.description: Parsed task input containing role, optional assignedFiles and verificationFiles.

inputs.name: taskGrantFiles.unit
inputs.description: Active module manifest from the selected committed source revision; owns.source is the implementation ownership boundary.

inputs.name: taskGrantFiles.tree
inputs.description: Commit-bound source tree whose list supplies the exact tracked file paths used for ownership resolution and existence checks.

inputs.name: validateTaskGrant.root
inputs.description: Working-tree root whose real path anchors physical file checks.

inputs.name: validateTaskGrant.files
inputs.description: Exact selected file grant returned by taskGrantFiles.

inputs.name: preparedTaskFiles.task
inputs.description: Stored task whose role, assignedFiles, verificationFiles and frozen module.files determine the prepared file list.

inputs.name: retryableTask.task
inputs.description: Stored task whose status and claim owner determine retry eligibility.

inputs.name: retryableTask.workspace
inputs.description: Current clone workspace identity compared with the task claim owner.

inputs.name: moduleTaskPrompt.task
inputs.description: Stored task from which the prompt content and wanted-contract integrity hash are read.

inputs.name: moduleTaskPrompt.commit
inputs.description: Task-queue commit string included in the prompt.

inputs.name: moduleTaskPrompt.files
inputs.description: Optional prepared exact file list; defaults to preparedTaskFiles(task).

inputs.name: moduleTaskPrompt.role
inputs.description: Optional task role; defaults to task.role or implementation for a legacy task.

inputs.name: taskSelection.task
inputs.description: The requested model selection fields; auto selection forbids an explicit provider or intelligence level.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskService.assign.id
inputs.description: Exact stored task id.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskService.assign.worker
inputs.description: Required worker id parsed with the same lowercase unit-style, maximum-150-character assignee schema used by task admission.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskService.repository
outputs.description: Instance property, not static. Public readonly ModuleTaskRepository constructed from root.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskService.feature
outputs.description: Instance method, not static. Parses input with featureSchema, then upserts by feature id through ModuleTaskRepository.update. A new feature is appended. An identical feature is an unchanged no-op. Reusing an id with different stableJson content throws; feature context is immutable and requires a new id. The update call omits source, so queue-parent, CAS retry and no-op commit semantics are those of the repository contract. ModuleTaskRepository may replay the update callback up to 16 times after a CAS loss; the callback contains no external side effects.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskService.add
outputs.description: Instance method, not static. Parses taskInputSchema and validates taskSelection, opens HEAD as one CommitTreeAdapter revision, reads that revision’s registry and requires the matching active module with owned source. Derived responsibility requires moduleGoal. Before any repository update it resolves role-specific exact files with taskGrantFiles and validates tracked and working-tree targets with validateTaskGrant. For implementation, assignedFiles if supplied must be a nonempty subset of committed module-owned non-test source; when omitted, all tracked files matching owns.source are selected, excluding verification paths. For verification, assignedFiles if supplied must be a nonempty subset of verificationFiles; when omitted, verificationFiles is selected. It rejects unsafe/noncanonical paths, duplicates, case aliases, unowned or mixed-role files, paths absent from the selected revision, directories, symlink targets or parents, and hard links before queue mutation. The queue stores the validated files in module.files, freezing scope at admission; sourceCommit is the selected tree revision and contractHash is SHA-256 of stableJson(wantedContract). Inside one repository update it rejects duplicate task ids, requires the referenced feature, appends the queued record, and passes the source revision as update source. The repository callback may replay on compare-and-swap loss; source HEAD and index remain unchanged. A successful repeated add is non-idempotent because duplicate ids are rejected.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskService.list
outputs.type: Promise<{features: TaskFeature[]; tasks: ModuleTask[]; commit: string | undefined}>
outputs.description: Instance method, not static. Projects the repository read snapshot into features, tasks and its task-ref commit. An absent queue has the repository contract's empty version-1 data and an undefined commit. Read-only; does not mutate task data.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskService.schema
outputs.type: JSON Schema object returned by z.toJSONSchema(taskInputSchema)
outputs.description: Instance method, not static. Machine-readable schema for the exact taskInputSchema consumed by add. Read-only; does not mutate task data.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskService.show
outputs.description: Instance method, not static. Returns the exact matching task and commit from list. Does not mutate the queue. Read-only; does not mutate task data.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskService.prompt
outputs.description: Instance method, not static. Returns prepare(task, commit).prompt for the exact task found by show. The prompt checks SHA-256 over stableJson(wantedContract), starts with the shared feature goal and TLDR, grants contract-only app-wide discovery, and states the role and exact prepared files. It includes module/task details, revisions, latest review feedback when present, queue commit and serialized wanted contract. Read-only. It also runs taskSelection, so model/provider/intelligence validation errors propagate.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskService.prepare
outputs.type: {prompt: string; selection: TaskSelection; files: string[]; role: 'implementation' | 'verification'}
outputs.description: Instance method, not static. Instance method, synchronous and not static. Returns the contract-checked prompt, exact model selection, prepared file grant and role without persistence. preparedTaskFiles intersects assignedFiles (or legacy module.files) with frozen module.files; implementation removes verificationFiles and test-path entries, while verification retains only explicitly listed verificationFiles matching test paths. This safely reduces legacy mixed source/test lists without broadening them. taskSelection behavior is unchanged: auto selects claude-haiku-5-5 / claude / medium and forbids overrides; explicit claude-* and gpt-* models infer their providers; other model ids require provider; intelligence defaults to medium; claude plus ultra is rejected.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskService.retry
outputs.description: Instance method, not static. Gets the current repository owner, then requeues only a failed task or a running task whose claim belongs to this workspace and whose claimed process is confirmed gone or has a different known start time. Other states, another workspace, a still-matching live process, or a live process with no known start time are rejected. Before requeue it appends an existing result to attempts and an existing claim to claimHistory, deletes result and claim, and sets status queued. It omits source from repository.update. A repeated call after the task has become queued is rejected, so the operation is not API-idempotent. No cancellation is performed or exposed. The repository update follows its CAS retry semantics and preserves source HEAD and the index.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskService.review
outputs.description: Instance method, not static. Returns the delegated reviewModuleTask result unchanged. That dependency's committed contract currently declares its output as unknown, so the concrete return and review mutation semantics remain an explicit dependency-contract gap. Review result shape, idempotency, cancellation, and state transition remain unknown pending that dependency contract.

outputs.name: queuedTask
outputs.description: Exported module function from src/services/agents-providers/module-task-service/queuedTask.ts. Exported module-level function, not a ModuleTaskService static method. Creates the queued record, freezes the supplied files argument into module.files, stores role/assignedFiles from input, sourceCommit, empty attempts/reviews/claimHistory and SHA-256 of stableJson(wantedContract). Its optional files parameter defaults to input.assignedFiles, otherwise verificationFiles for verification, otherwise raw unit.owns.source. That default is not an admission check and does not expand ownership patterns; callers that bypass ModuleTaskService.add must resolve and physically validate the grant with taskGrantFiles and validateTaskGrant before calling queuedTask, and pass the validated files.

outputs.name: taskGrantFiles
outputs.description: Exported module function from src/services/agents-providers/module-task-service/queuedTask.ts. Exported module-level async function, not a ModuleTaskService static method. Resolves a nonempty exact grant against the selected registry and commit tree. Implementation grants must match owns.source and exclude verification paths; absent assignedFiles defaults to tracked owned non-test files. Verification grants must be explicit test paths from verificationFiles; absent assignedFiles defaults to that list. It checks canonical relative names, duplicate and case aliases, role boundaries, exact ownership, exact case and tracked-file existence. Throws Error for an empty or unsafe grant, duplicate/aliased paths, unowned or mixed-role files, or a path absent from the selected commit. It does not mutate the task repository.

outputs.name: validateTaskGrant
outputs.description: Exported module function from src/services/agents-providers/module-task-service/queuedTask.ts. Exported module-level async function, not a ModuleTaskService static method. Resolves root and checks each selected path component by exact directory entry and lstat, rejects symlinks and non-directory parents, requires a regular target with link count one, then opens with O_NOFOLLOW where available and verifies the file again. Throws Error for missing, directory, symlink or hard-link targets and symlink parents; filesystem failures reject the promise. It is read-only.

outputs.name: preparedTaskFiles
outputs.description: Exported module function from src/services/agents-providers/module-task-service/taskPrompt.ts. Exported module-level function, not a ModuleTaskService static method. Returns only files in frozen module.files and, when present, assignedFiles. Implementation excludes verificationFiles and test-path entries; verification includes only explicit verificationFiles that are test paths. Legacy tasks without assignedFiles safely reduce their frozen mixed list without adding files.

outputs.name: retryableTask
outputs.description: Exported module function from src/services/agents-providers/module-task-service/retryableTask.ts. Exported module-level function, not a ModuleTaskService static method. Returns true for any failed task. Otherwise returns true only for a running task whose claim owner workspace matches the supplied workspace and whose ProcessIdentityAdapter facts say the claimed pid does not exist, or that it exists with a nonempty startedAt unequal to the claim owner’s startedAt. All other states and observations return false.

outputs.name: moduleTaskPrompt
outputs.description: Exported module function from src/services/agents-providers/module-task-service/taskPrompt.ts. Exported module-level function, not a ModuleTaskService static method. Rejects a task when SHA-256 of stableJson(wantedContract) differs from contractHash; otherwise returns the newline-joined role-specific prompt. The overall feature goal and TLDR are first. It allows app-wide committed contract discovery only, states the exact allowed files and role-specific capability, prohibits widening grants, delegation, commits, pushes, deploys, credential access and self-acceptance, and preserves task/review/revision/queue details plus serialized wanted contract. Latest review feedback is accessed through reviews.at(-1).feedback when present.

outputs.name: taskSelection
outputs.description: Exported module function from src/services/agents-providers/module-task-service/taskPrompt.ts. Exported module-level function, not a ModuleTaskService static method. For model auto, rejects provider or intelligence overrides and returns claude-haiku-5-5 / claude / medium. Otherwise uses the explicit provider or infers claude from a claude-* model and codex from a gpt-* model; it rejects an unrecognized model without explicit provider and rejects claude plus ultra. The selected intelligence defaults to medium.

outputs.name: ModuleTask
outputs.type: Omit<ModuleTaskInput, 'module' | 'feature'> & {feature: TaskFeature; module: {id: string; goal: string; files: string[]}; sourceCommit: string; contractHash: string; status: 'queued' | 'running' | 'review' | 'failed' | 'accepted'; repairCommit?: string; reviews: TaskReview[]; createdAt: string; claim?: TaskClaim; claimHistory: TaskClaim[]; result?: StoredTaskResult; attempts: StoredTaskResult[]}
outputs.description: Committed repository task record with module.files as the immutable selected role-specific file list. ModuleTaskInput fields assignedFiles?: string[] and role are retained; parsed role defaults to implementation. assignedFiles is optional and, when present, is a nonempty list of at most 64 canonical exact relative file names. Stored sourceCommit is a 40-character lowercase commit id, contractHash a 64-character lowercase digest, and createdAt ISO text. Array defaults are empty. TaskClaim contains worker id, UUID token, ISO startedAt and owner {workspace UUID, positive pid, startedAt text}. TaskReview and StoredTaskResult fields, including usage/execution/cost, remain as described by the existing task-usage dependency contract.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskService.assign
outputs.description: Atomically changes only the assignee of an untouched queued ad hoc task using the replay-safe repository update. Rejects any task named by any stored plan revision, with a claim, result, repair revision, claim history, attempt or review. Existing source commit, wanted contract, hash, file grants and all other fields remain unchanged. Repeating the same assignment is a no-op. It does not launch a worker or provider.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: featureSchema or taskInputSchema rejects malformed input, including invalid role, assignedFiles, verificationFiles or wantedContract. The underlying ModuleTaskRepository schemas may also reject persisted queue data.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Propagates service policy failures (conflicting immutable feature id; inactive/unregistered or source-less module; derived placeholder responsibility without moduleGoal; empty, unsafe, duplicate, case-aliased, unowned or mixed-role file grants; paths absent from the selected revision; directories, symlink targets/parents or hard-link targets; duplicate task id; missing feature/task; non-retryable task), taskSelection validation failures, wanted-contract hash mismatch, repository callback/Git/filesystem failures and CAS exhaustion after 16 update attempts. add performs grant resolution and physical checks before repository.update. ModuleTaskRepository.owner may fail on malformed persisted owner identity or inability to establish process start time. Review dependency errors also propagate. This service does not call repository sync.

errors.name: Unsafe task grant
errors.description: Rejects noncanonical or empty assignments, duplicates and case aliases, implementation files outside committed module ownership, verification files outside the explicit test grant, mixed-role grants, incorrect case, and selected paths absent from the committed source tree. The helper is read-only; ModuleTaskService.add calls it before queue mutation.

errors.name: Unsafe working-tree target
errors.description: Rejects missing targets, directories, symlink targets, symlink parents and hard-linked targets. It validates exact path components under the resolved working-tree root and opens the target with O_NOFOLLOW where supported. It performs no writes.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Propagated by the repository contract when a task-ref queue.json is invalid JSON.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: May propagate from committed source tree or registry reads; exact validation conditions are owned by the CommitTreeAdapter and UnitRegistryRepository contracts.

errors.name: Invalid or ineligible assignment
errors.description: An invalid worker id, missing task, non-queued task, task with execution history or a task referenced by any stored feature plan rejects without changing the queue.
